sentences.text: Today we will talk about India.
India is a big and colorful country in South Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is India?
India is in South Asia.
It is between Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.
To the south, India touches the Indian Ocean.
India is the 7th largest country in the world.
It has many landscapes, mountains, rivers, deserts, and beaches.
What is the capital city of India?
The capital city is New Delhi.
It is part of a bigger city called Delhi.
New Delhi has government buildings, museums, and parks.
Other big cities in India are Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.
India has many large and busy cities.
How many people live in India?
India has more than one 4 billion people.
It is one of the most populated countries in the world.
Many people live in cities, but many also live in villages and small towns.
India has a young population.
Many people are children or teenagers.
What languages do people speak in India?
India has many languages, more than 20 official languages.
Two main official languages are Hindi and English.
English is used in business, government, and schools.
Hindi is spoken by many people, especially in the north.
Other languages include Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Gujarati, Punjabi, Urdu, and more.
India is a multilingual country.
People often speak two or three languages.
What is the weather like in India?
India has different weather in different places.
In the north, there are cold mountains.
In the south, it is hot and humid.
India has three main seasons.
Summer, hot and dry, monsoon, rainy season from June to September.
Winter cooler from November to February.
In some places, summer can be very hot over 40 degrees Celsius.
What does India look like?
India has many different landscapes.
The Himalayas in the north, with snow and tall mountains.
The Ganges River, which is important in Indian culture.
The Thar desert in the west, green forests and jungles, long beaches and beautiful coasts.
India is a land of variety and contrast.
Cities are busy and villages are calm.
What animals live in India?
India has many wild animals.
You can find elephants, tigers, monkeys, peacocks, the national bird, cobras, cows, which are special in Hindu culture.
There are many national parks to protect animals.
You can go on safaris to see them.
What do people eat in India?
Indian food is famous around the world.
It is often spicy and full of flavor.
People eat rice, bread, like naan, roti and chapati, lentils, called dal, vegetables, spices and chili.
Curry, a sauce with meat or vegetables.
Samosas, fried pastry with potatoes and peas.
Many people in India are vegetarian.
In the south, people eat more coconut, rice and fish.
For dessert, there are sweets like gulab jamun, laddu and kheer, rice pudding.
What do people drink in India?
The most popular drink is chai, Indian tea with milk and spices.
People also drink coffee, fruit juices and lassi, a yogurt drink.
Clean drinking water is very important.
In many places, people boil water or use filters.
What is life like in India?
Life in India is busy and diverse.
People go to school, go to work and enjoy time with family.
Many people work in technology, farming, business or transportation.
India is known for information technology and movies.
Families are important.
Often many generations live together.
Grandparents, parents and children.
What are some festivals in India?
India has many colorful and fun festivals.
Some of them are Diwali, the festival of lights.
Holi, the festival of colors.
Eid, celebrated by Muslims.
Christmas, celebrated by Christians.
Pongal, Navratri, Durga Pooja, Onam and many more.
People wear traditional clothes, eat special food and celebrate with music and dance.
Some fun facts about India.
India is the world's largest democracy.
Yoga and chess began in India.
The Taj Mahal is one of the seven wonders of the world.
The Indian flag has three colors.
Orange, white and green with a blue wheel in the center.
Bollywood, the Indian film industry makes more movies than Hollywood.
Now you know many things about India.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the festivals, animals, food and everyday life.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I am Emily.
